Installer ownership checks could claim user commands containing `codecortex`, delete neighboring user hooks, or report malformed configuration removal as success. The first archive publisher could overwrite a pointer created by another writer after its initial check. Unchanged index scans also retained an owned action entry for every unchanged file.

## Changes

- Match Claude Code hooks by exact owned command and event shape, preserve neighboring commands, and validate configuration before changing other files.
- Reject malformed generic JSON installer sections and preserve bytes when uninstall has nothing to remove.
- Publish an initially absent archive `latest` pointer with create-if-absent semantics; retain existing-owned pointer update behavior.
- Keep only add/update/dirty-resolution actions in the scan action map, with scanned-path membership representing unchanged files. Existing scan, hashing, resolver, resource, and admission budgets remain in force.

The product commit changes exactly eight Rust source/test files and two Python validation files. A separate independent source review inventories all 1,096 product inputs and 142 validation inputs. The final admission commit changes only the four v15 source/review pins and its registry. Existing approval algorithms, historical snapshots, CI selection, and source exclusions remain unchanged.

## Validation and limits

Focused regressions passed on their recorded reviewed sources, including 56 installer unit tests, five installer CLI tests, 42 archive-publication tests, and 36 distinct index planning/reconciliation tests. Independent reviewers additionally checked ownership, failure preservation, first-publication races, and dense/sparse action equivalence. These executions retain their original source identities; identical product bytes are not described as a new execution on this PR head.

Prior integration validation passed formatting, workspace clippy, compilation of default targets, 421 P8 Python tests, the completed remaining Rust targets, and the named fixture/corpus test. Two unchanged default runtime tests failed in the local execution environment and are not waived. The complete historical source proof is also locally blocked by two unavailable original binary Git inputs. Ordinary GitHub CI on the final PR head is required before merge.

No full-build performance improvement, full-scale acceptance, original TODO completion, or release certification is claimed. The sparse-action measurements concern only that component.

## Original TODO accounting

The original ledger remains 192 total: 163 done, 16 in progress, 12 todo, and one blocked; 29 remain. This PR contributes four scoped fixes and claims zero newly completed original TODOs. P8-005 full-scale evidence still gates the next original acceptance sequence. No existing expensive study is duplicated or dispatched by this PR workflow.

## Why

The original fixed-source cold study has completed all five declared scales, while the roadmap still marks P8-005 in progress. This PR records that completed scope and its recoverable original evidence.

## Changes

- Mark only **P8-005** done and advance `next_task` to **P8-006**. The inventory remains 192 original tasks: 164 done and 28 remaining.
- Append the fixed `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39` / run `37954851017` / attempt 1 evidence: five scales × 30 original paired cold samples, 300 fresh builds, and full parity across all 15 canonical tables.
- Link the original aggregate and the [complete 150-slot custody ledger](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/a2daea38bc72cb3cf9c95535b852fff214debf2b/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round28-cold150-complete-custody-ledger-bfcc-20261009/complete-cold150-custody-ledger.json), including every original measurement/capacity ZIP, chunk restoration manifest where applicable, build, and aggregate.
- Regenerate the four existing roadmap views using the unmodified `scripts/code_index_plan.py`.

## Scope and preserved contracts

All other 191 task objects, task identities, dependencies, acceptance text, and prior evidence remain unchanged. The existing historical guard permits task changes only in `status`, `evidence`, and `implementation_notes`; the protected historical `acceptance_subgates` map therefore retains its original bytes, and current cold-scale closure is stated explicitly in the appended progress evidence.

This records cold measurement coverage. Vectors were explicitly disabled and have `count: null`; 300 resource observations are snapshots, and each original environment stratum has n=1. No pooled tail, confidence-interval, causal-speedup, real-provider, whole-V20, release-certification, or downstream-task completion claim is added. Original failed and partial studies retain their identities.

## Validation

The original generator `python3 scripts/code_index_plan.py --write` and its unmodified no-argument check both returned exit 0 on the final files. The original cold aggregate and independent intake accepted all 150 unique samples, and the complete custody ledger matches all 150 original receipt digests. Historical engineering regressions retain their actual PR189 checkout identity; they are not relabelled as executions of this documentation commit.

This commit is based on main `51138c236cf2ed47858e2306f9c7bfd3600aaef9`, which already contains PR #196. Its exact diff is five documentation/progress files; product code, workflows, source admission algorithms, and bindings are unchanged. Current PR checks remain separate from the recorded historical measurement evidence.

Independent non-author review has accepted the final five-file scope and verified the exact commit/tree, all 191 unchanged tasks, original workload counts, complete custody pointer, and both successful generator receipts. Its publication record will be appended without changing the reviewed files.

The original fixed-source cold study has completed all five declared scales, while the roadmap still marks P8-005 in progress. This PR records that completed scope and its recoverable original evidence.

## Changes

- Mark only **P8-005** done and advance `next_task` to **P8-006**. The inventory remains 192 original tasks: 164 done and 28 remaining.
- Append the fixed `044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39` / run `37954851017` / attempt 1 evidence: five scales × 30 original paired cold samples, 300 fresh builds, and full parity across all 15 canonical tables.
- Link the original aggregate and the [complete 150-slot custody ledger](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/a2daea38bc72cb3cf9c95535b852fff214debf2b/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round28-cold150-complete-custody-ledger-bfcc-20261009/complete-cold150-custody-ledger.json), including every original measurement/capacity ZIP, chunk restoration manifest where applicable, build, and aggregate.
- Regenerate the four existing roadmap views using the unmodified `scripts/code_index_plan.py`.

## Scope and preserved contracts

All other 191 task objects, task identities, dependencies, acceptance text, and prior evidence remain unchanged. The existing historical guard permits task changes only in `status`, `evidence`, and `implementation_notes`; the protected historical `acceptance_subgates` map therefore retains its original bytes, and current cold-scale closure is stated explicitly in the appended progress evidence.

This records cold measurement coverage. Vectors were explicitly disabled and have `count: null`; 300 resource observations are snapshots, and each original environment stratum has n=1. No pooled tail, confidence-interval, causal-speedup, real-provider, whole-V20, release-certification, or downstream-task completion claim is added. Original failed and partial studies retain their identities.

## Validation

The original generator `python3 scripts/code_index_plan.py --write` and its unmodified no-argument check both returned exit 0 on the final files. The original cold aggregate and independent intake accepted all 150 unique samples, and the complete custody ledger matches all 150 original receipt digests. Historical engineering regressions retain their actual PR189 checkout identity; they are not relabelled as executions of this documentation commit.

This commit is based on main `51138c236cf2ed47858e2306f9c7bfd3600aaef9`, which already contains PR #196. Its exact diff is five documentation/progress files; product code, workflows, source admission algorithms, and bindings are unchanged. Current PR checks remain separate from the recorded historical measurement evidence.

Independent non-author review has accepted the final five-file scope and verified the exact commit/tree, all 191 unchanged tasks, original workload counts, complete custody pointer, and both successful generator receipts. Its publication record will be appended without changing the reviewed files.
